title: The Divide-and-Conquer Strategy: Defeat Them in Detail
coreMove: Loosen a coalition by finding a real existing disagreement and dealing with the fragments after unity weakens.
sourcePressure: A united opponent is stronger than its parts; a divided one is weaker, but a clumsy wedge can create solidarity.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Invent division or attack noisily enough to unify the other side.

hook: Do not open with a battlefield metaphor for The Divide-and-Conquer Strategy: Defeat Them in Detail.
Do not start by saying strategy is not about violence.
counterintuition: Avoid the reusable correction frame that the move is not X but Y.
Avoid a bland paradox about strength looking like weakness.
tryThisNow: No generic timer, pause, breathe, or list-three-options prompt.
No reusable ask what matters most prompt.
examples: No generic founder in a pitch deck unless the domain requires it.
No battlefield reenactment or invented historical anecdote.
